cards.public_summary: Josh Jacobs was placed on the commissioner’s exempt list last week following misdemeanor battery and criminal-destruction charges.
cards.evidence: Last week, Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs was placed on the commissioner's exempt list due to his misdemeanor charges for battery and criminal destruction of property. For fantasy purposes, the commissioner's exempt list is essentially an indefinite suspension; however, in the NFL, it's technically not a suspension at all because, while the player is not allowed to play or practice with their team, they still get paid.
cards.commentary: Jacobs cannot practice or play while on the exempt list, creating an immediate absence for fantasy lineups. The source provides no timetable or resolution of the charges.
cards.author: Mark Morales-Smith
